retractions.reason: The v0.11 acceptance criterion "one shared `max_distance` constant" was false: maintenance writes used DEDUP_MAX_DISTANCE, but the production ingest handler still passed a separate literal 16.

The v0.12.0 R-CLOSE HC2 claim was falsified by measurement: an entering-state finance-scoped /attest request returned a violation naming out-of-sector science::b. Released v0.12.0 hydrated /retrieve and /attest through the public unscoped documents_by_ids method, and /attest had no sector field. The live exposure was a cross-sector existence-and-16-token-match oracle, not a document-body leak.

THRESHOLD-ONE recorded that every production path selected DEDUP_MAX_DISTANCE inside the store, but v0.12 R5 only rejected numeric call arguments and second threshold declarations; rematerialize_canonical_ids_with_distance still forwarded a production max_distance parameter, so a renamed non-numeric threshold could evade the claimed correction.
